savedASC.description:
Bring your calendars and weather into one planning app for iPhone and iPad. See work and personal plans together, check the forecast and choose a calendar view that fits your day.

YOUR CALENDARS, TOGETHER
Use iCloud calendars and connect Google Calendar. Premium adds Microsoft Calendar support. Or start with a local calendar on your device without creating an account. Connecting providers and sharing require sign-in where applicable.

A VIEW FOR EVERY PLAN
Switch between Day, Week, Month, Year and List views. Use multiple calendars to keep different parts of your schedule visible in one place.

WEATHER WHILE YOU PLAN
Check weather forecasts alongside your plans, explore detailed weather views and use the interactive weather map with wind and temperature layers. Forecast availability depends on your location and the weather provider.

HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
See calendar information and weather from your Home Screen, with small, medium and large widget options.

MEETINGS AND SHARING
Use Google Meet support with Google Calendar. Premium adds Microsoft Teams support. Share events and calendars with email or QR invitations. App Clip offers an event preview; adding the event through that experience requires the full app. Sharing access depends on the calendar and invitation type.

CHOOSE YOUR PLAN
The free Base plan includes Google Calendar sync, Google Meet support, multiple calendar views, weather and widgets.
Advanced includes Base features and removes ads.
Premium includes Advanced features and adds Microsoft Calendar and Microsoft Teams support.

Cloud Calendars is free to download with optional auto-renewing subscriptions. Check current local prices in the app or App Store. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at purchase confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before that period ends. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://www.cloud-calendars.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

findings.claim: The app uses Apple WeatherKit; website demo uses Open-Meteo.
findings.basis: Both full immutable native files use WeatherService; WindMapForecastCache grid, WeatherMapPlaceCache hourly/current request paths still WeatherKit. Current website service uses api.open-meteo.com with14forecastdays. No new non-Apple weather provider found in scope.

findings.claim: Daily app list up to ten returned WeatherKit days; hourly availability separate.
findings.basis: updateDailyForecast still prefixes min(days.count,10). Map grid asks a finite25hour window beginning4hours before rounded current hour; place forecast asks minus4hours through plus24hours. These requests do not establish universal coverage or10day map timeline.

findings.claim: ASC interactive weather map with wind and temperature layers; availability depends on location/provider.
findings.basis: WindMapStore supports wind/temperature layer summaries and finite cached point/grid requests. Saved description already describes these without promising instant/fixed/complete coverage.

findings.claim: Selected-place weather and device-location alert paths differ.
findings.basis: WeatherKitVM still invokes processFetchedGPSAlerts only under isGPSLocation. New task ordering does not turn destination forecasts into guaranteed notifications.
